data.content_ref: inline:Fold witness construction into the Pass 1 iteration itself: each iteration attaches to an accepted node the defenders that justify it in that very round, so the DefenseWitness is co-constructed with the label rather than materialized post-hoc. This makes the witness part of the fixed point and deterministically tied to the iteration, but requires re-proving that the witness-carrying labels still form a monotone operator and that co-iteration stays polynomial.
